results.name: Adult Community Basketball
results.description: Drop-in pickup basketball for adults at the Southside community center. Players shoot around or join casual games; no registration needed.
results.home_base: Dr. Wesley Grant Sr. Southside Community Center
results.notes: Seasonal city rec drop-in on Mountain Xpress; grey, kept. No own site found.

results.name: Appalachian Healing Collective
results.description: A participant-led healing circle where attendees offer and receive reiki, sound, massage and other energy work. Gatherings are held at The Well in Asheville.
results.notes: Only 3 Eventbrite events, last April 2026. Grey, kept; no website found.

results.name: Asheville Area Business Association
results.description: Business networking group.
results.notes: Business networking clubs and mixers; excluded as business-development programming.

results.name: Asheville Bridge Room
results.description: A bridge club that offers beginner lessons and regular games for players of all levels. Meets at Congregation Beth Israel.
results.notes: Search confirms club with manager and lessons at Beth Israel; bridgewebs.com/avl listed as its site.

results.name: Asheville Darts Meetup Group
results.description: A social dart league for players of all levels, playing a modified version of Cricket. Meets weekly at a South Slope bar.
results.notes: Meetup events through May 2026; no independent site found.

results.name: Asheville Guitar League
results.description: A guitar community that holds a monthly song circle for players of all skill levels to learn, play and share songs. Meets at a Fairview brewery.
results.notes: Mountain Xpress and Meetup show a 3rd-Saturday song circle at Turgua; site not confirmed.

results.name: Asheville Millennials
results.description: A social group for local millennials that organizes regular outings such as brewery nights, coffee runs, pinball and concerts.
results.notes: 21 Meetup events, 3 upcoming; clear social group.

results.name: Asheville Quilt Guild
results.description: A membership guild of quilters founded in 1988 that meets monthly and runs a quilting bee and an annual public quilt show.
results.notes: Known site; 300+ member guild with committees.

results.name: Asheville Sport and Social Club
results.description: A recreational sports league organization whose volleyball league plays weekly on the meadow at Highland Brewing, with post-game socializing.
results.notes: Registration-based rec league operator; borderline business but kept as grey with returning teams.

results.name: Asheville YMCA Crafting Club
results.description: A free monthly gathering for crafters of all skill levels to knit, scrapbook, paint and share projects. Meets at the Asheville YMCA.
results.notes: YMCA-hosted free recurring club; separate from the Ferguson YMCA club.

results.name: AVL LGBT+ Meetupppers
results.description: A social meetup for lesbian, bisexual and LGBTQ+ women aged 40 and over to make friends over drinks or dinner.
results.notes: Single Meetup event June 2026; grey, kept.

results.name: Black Experience Book Club
results.description: A monthly book club reading literature centered on the voices and histories of the African Diaspora. Meets at the YMI Cultural Center or Noir Collective AVL.
results.notes: Events consistently monthly at YMI; no own site found.

results.name: Carolina Mountain Club
results.description: The region's long-running hiking and trail maintenance club, leading hikes at many difficulty levels around Western North Carolina.
results.notes: Founded 1923 in Asheville; membership club with 200+ hikes a year per its site.

results.name: Community Ceramics
results.description: A ceramics studio offering paid workshops.
results.notes: One paid $125 workshop; studio business. Same as m:community-ceramics.

results.name: Dark City Blues Jam
results.description: A twice-monthly blues jam presented by the Black Mountain Blues Society, with a house band and sign-up for musicians to sit in.
results.notes: Exploreasheville confirms BMBS-presented jam; kept as a community of regular blues players.

results.name: Drugs Are Whack
results.description: A weekly virtual 12-step recovery meeting hosted by the Asheville 12 Step Club.
results.notes: Weekly virtual meeting, last listed March 2026; no own site found.

results.name: Family & Systemic Constellations in Asheville
results.description: Facilitated group workshops using family constellation work to explore family and collective patterns.
results.notes: Facilitator-led sessions, no member community evident; 2 events.

results.name: Game Designers of North Carolina
results.description: A group of tabletop game designers who meet to playtest prototypes and give each other feedback. The Asheville chapter meets at a board game cafe.
results.home_base: Well Played Board Game Cafe, Asheville
results.notes: Search confirms statewide group with an Asheville chapter.

results.name: Hendo Fun Friends
results.description: A Hendersonville-area social group that shares local events such as concerts, bluegrass nights and community celebrations.
results.notes: Same group as m:hendo-fun-friends; mostly event notices.

results.name: Inner Peace Collective
results.description: A meditation and sound healing community in Asheville, including an ongoing group called the Polyvagal Sangha.
results.notes: Mostly ticketed sound sessions but a sangha element; grey, kept.

results.name: Junk Journaling Club
results.description: A casual craft club where makers of all skill levels cut, collage and create mixed media journal pages together.
results.notes: Recurring Folkmoot Center club.

results.name: Leveller Traditional Irish Session
results.description: A traditional Irish music session where local players trade tunes at a Weaverville brewery. Listeners are welcome.
results.notes: Regular session hosted by a local musician.

results.name: Meaningful Conversations Asheville
results.description: An interfaith discussion group that holds free, open conversations on spirituality and community topics.
results.notes: 18 Meetup events, all free discussions.

results.name: Midweek Melee
results.description: A Super Smash Bros. community that holds weekly Melee and Ultimate tournaments for players of all skill levels.
results.notes: Meetup events Feb to Mar 2026; coordinates on Discord.

results.name: National Speakers Association Western North Carolina
results.description: The local chapter of the National Speakers Association, a peer group for professional speakers, coaches, trainers and consultants.
results.notes: Professional association chapter; kept as a peer group, not lead generation.

results.name: Old Fort Women's MTB Club
results.description: A monthly mountain bike ride for women in the Old Fort area, welcoming all levels.
results.notes: Instagram handle from event description; not verified by search.

results.name: Pack Memorial Library Tween Dungeons & Dragons
results.description: A monthly Dungeons & Dragons game for ages 10 to 12 at Pack Memorial Library. Free, with registration by email.
results.notes: Matches the library teen D&D group approved earlier.

results.name: Random Wild Adventures
results.description: An outdoor adventure group that organizes mountain bike rides and other outings around Western North Carolina.
results.notes: Single Meetup event May 2026; grey, kept.

results.name: Sacred Women's Circle Asheville
results.description: An earth-centered women's circle blending sound, poetry and movement in a ritual setting.
results.notes: Single Meetup event May 2026; grey, kept.

results.name: Sit a Spell
results.description: A weekly traditional music jam hosted by Ginger's Revenge with Warren Wilson College. Musicians of all levels bring instruments to play.
results.notes: Open roots-music jam that benefits the college music scholarship.

results.name: Spanish Conversation Practice Group
results.description: A friendly group for beginning and intermediate Spanish speakers to practice conversation using prompts and games.
results.notes: Library-hosted recurring practice group.

results.name: Swannanoa Grassroots Alliance
results.description: A Swannanoa neighbor-led group that holds open weekly community meetings to share resources and support recovery.
results.notes: Search confirms SGA works with county on Swannanoa planning.

results.name: The Men's Nest
results.description: A free weekly peer-led support circle for men and male-identifying people to connect and give and receive support. A SeekHealing program.
results.notes: Search confirms it is a SeekHealing circle; own URL not found.

results.name: Tuesday Night Magic at The Local Collective
results.description: A weekly Magic: The Gathering night for local players at The Local Collective in Weaverville.
results.notes: Weekly MTG regulars; grey, kept.

results.name: Weaverville Community Center Women's Group
results.description: A monthly women's gathering with a guest speaker and time to mingle afterward. Meets at the Weaverville Community Center.
results.notes: Recurring monthly group at the center.

results.name: White Horse Irish Session
results.description: A traditional Irish music session where players trade reels and jigs at White Horse in Black Mountain.
results.notes: Regular session on venue calendars.

results.name: WNC Sierra Club
results.description: The Western North Carolina group of the Sierra Club, hosting monthly environmental talks, hikes and outings.
results.home_base: OLLI at UNC Asheville and trails
results.notes: Chapter group; site not confirmed.

results.name: Youngblood Bicycles Thursday Road Ride
results.description: A standing weekly group road ride from Youngblood Bicycles with two paces and routes of about 26 and 33 miles.
results.schedule: Thursdays at 6 PM in daylight saving time
results.notes: Standing ride with regulars; kept per shop-ride rule.
